newsitem.title: USA: American Annuity plans offering. [CORRECTED 16:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: American Annuity plans offering. [CORRECTED 16:00 GMT]

text.p: American Annuity Group Inc said it has filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a public offering of three million trust originated preferred securities at $25 (corrects from $26) each.

The securities will be issued by American Annuity Group Capital Trust I, a Delaware statutory business trust controlled by American Annuity, which will exist solely as a finance vehicle for the company and its subsidiaries.
The securities represent a preferred undivided beneficial interest in the assets of the trust.
Merrill Lynch is the lead manager of the underwriting group for the offering.
American Annuity said it plans to use the net proceeds of the proposed offering to repay outstanding debt and for general corporate purposes.
